correction.finding: Scenes S009, S010, and S011 depict a high-risk sequence involving an open vessel fire ignited by a flare gun, overhead fireworks mortars, nighttime open-water operations, and a character diving into cold harbor water. If pyrotechnic special effects are utilized practically, applicable safety standards require that any necessary licenses and permits be obtained from the proper Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) over pyrotechnic materials prior to use, and that Pyrotechnic Special Effects Operators hold valid State and Federal licenses. Additionally, because the sequence depicts water immersion and night water exposure, safety guidelines advise monitoring water temperature, watching cast and crew for signs of hypothermia, and taking proactive steps to prevent hypothermia during water work. Production execution methods, jurisdiction, and casting remain unconfirmed.
correction.remedy_detail: If practical pyrotechnics or open flame effects are staged, engage a licensed Pyrotechnic Special Effects Operator holding valid State and Federal licenses, and secure all required permits from the relevant Authorities Having Jurisdiction over pyrotechnic materials. For any cast or crew working in water, establish water-temperature monitoring and protocols to prevent and identify hypothermia. Confirm the planned execution method (practical open-water staging vs. controlled tank or visual effects), casting, and shooting jurisdiction.
